mints.narrow: Mint the read-only proof identity without variables

readings.what: a repository variable read with `gh variable get`, which needs `variables: read`
readings.why: DRE-6543 and DRE-6478: the wide mint asks for `variables: read`, no installation on record grants it, and the narrow mint reads no variable
readings.brief: It reads repo variables (`gh variable get`) only where the installation grants `variables: read`

readings.what: the console database read through `make db-read`
readings.why: DRE-6543: `make db-read` runs under the operator's AWS profile, which the workflow never hands a proof run
readings.brief: You hold exactly what the workflow hands you

readings.why: DRE-6543 row 4: a step summary is not among the GitHub reads the proof identity makes; a tagged line is read from the run's log instead
readings.brief: Every observation of GitHub — a run's status, a tag, a pull request's checks and verdicts, a repo variable — is made as this token

readings.why: DRE-6431 row 6 and DRE-6442 row 6: the read token reaches the caller's own organization only
readings.brief: It does not reach a repository in other organizations

readings.what: a `Local screen:` page the repo's `.github/bureau/proof-local.json` does not declare
readings.why: briefs/proof.md: the local run opens only the pages the repo declares, by key
readings.brief: The criterion names a page by its key in that file.

readings.what: the product's own scripted proof identities, reached through the caller's `PROOF_ROLE_ARN`
readings.why: briefs/proof.md: only a caller that provides `PROOF_ROLE_ARN` hands the run an AWS session, and portico is the one that does today
readings.brief: When no caller provides one, the Identities section records `aws: none`

log_lines.when: every proof run, in its log and its step summary
every proof run, in its log and its step summary, from proof-task.yml's local-run step
every job a wiring card places the emit step in, one line per login, since DRE-6914

every selecting run since DRE-6939: the selector reads the home when it first answers a choice, before it prints the model id, and the reader prints the line to stderr, so it is in the `Select model` step's log above the note
every run of `model-home-carry.yml` since DRE-6986, in its `Carry the merged choices into the home` step's log
every shadow replay since DRE-7193 and DRE-7194, one line in the `Write the shadow verdict` step's log: `qa-review.yml` prints it for the critic and `verify.yml` for the verifier
every run of `shadow-replay.yml` since DRE-7197, in its compare job's log: one line per replayed pull request, then one summary line
once per run of the planning classifier's cost tally since DRE-7196, when its Linear read succeeds

every surface job of `release-train.yml` since DRE-5235, in its `Run the surface` step's log: on a deferral that names no re-arm minute, the facts line and then the card lines; on a verified tag, the open-cards line and, when one was open, the closed line
